subject: Re: Immediate attention required — sustained throughput and 5xx spike (SigmaHealth)
messages:
From: Sara Patel <sara.patel@sigmahealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: SigmaHealth Legal <contracts@sigmahealth.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Sustained 5xx & throughput shortfall — urgent commercial remedy request

Ben —

We're seeing a sustained 5xx rate (peaking at ~4.7% over the last 6 hours) and average throughput at ~60% of our committed baseline across our primary production region. This is affecting our nightly batch scoring jobs and downstream clinical workflows. We elevated to our SRE (logs attached) and pulled traces; there are repeated model timeouts and queuing delays.

Our contract (SLA section 4.2) calls for 99.9% availability and a throughput commitment that you're aware of. Given the business impact — missed processing windows for several clinics — SigmaHealth will need an expedited proposal for:
- concrete remediation timeline,
- proposed service credit amount (we need an initial estimate for the exec review), and
- next steps for a formal contract amendment if necessary.

Please route to your leadership — Sara

Attachment: sigma-logs-20271120.zip (referenced)
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Patel <sara.patel@sigmahealth.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Nov 2027 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: Sustained 5xx & throughput shortfall — urgent commercial remedy request

Team — forwarding Sigma's escalation. Quick summary:
- 5xx spike started after a deploy at ~01:40 PT; error budget for this SLA window is already stressed.
- Sigma is seeing sustained throughput at ~60% of the committed baseline for their PROD pool.
- They are requesting an immediate remediation timeline, a service credit estimate, and contract amendment options.

Proposed immediate actions:
1) Roll the last deploy back in the affected AZs (can we push a rollback within 30m?)
2) Enable hardened routing to a pre-quantized model variant to reduce latency and error surface (temporary measure)
3) Prepare a credit estimate using the SLA formula in the contract; I attached my working calc (sla-calculation.xlsx).

Evelyn, can you own the remediation plan and run the rollback? Jonas, need your help on commercial (credit calc + contract language). Marissa, please prepare an executive one-pager for Sigma's leadership and our CSM. I'll join the 2pm PST post-mortem with Sigma.

Thanks — Ben

Attachments: sla-calculation.xlsx
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Sara Patel <sara.patel@sigmahealth.com>
Date: Sat, 20 Nov 2027 11:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Sustained 5xx & throughput shortfall — urgent commercial remedy request

On Sat, Nov 20, 2027 at 10:03 AM Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team — forwarding Sigma's escalation. Quick summary:
> - 5xx spike started after a deploy at ~01:40 PT; error budget for this SLA window is already stressed.

Rollback completed at 10:38 PT for the flagged model shard; observed immediate drop in 5xx to 0.4% within 7 minutes and throughput recovered to ~85% of baseline. We're still seeing higher tail latencies on longer sequences (95th percentile).

Temporary mitigations applied:
- Reverted to the previous model binary for shard A.
- Forced lower batch sizes on affected pools, disabled speculative retry to avoid amplifying load.
- Enabled KV cache warmup for Sigma's tenancy.

I'll run the full replay and confirm stability by EOD. I'll attach the runbook notes and the mitigation log.

Evelyn Hart
Sr. Site Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: prod-runbook.pdf, redwood-mitigation-notes.txt
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Sara Patel <sara.patel@sigmahealth.com>, SigmaHealth Legal <contracts@sigmahealth.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Nov 2027 14:20:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SLA credit estimate and proposed contract amendment language

Sara / SigmaHealth team —

First, apologies for the disruption. Thank you for the logs; they were helpful. Based on our rollback timeline and the contract's SLA calculation (days impacted * violation percent), our preliminary estimate is a one-time service credit equal to 9% of the monthly committed fee for the affected month (working doc attached: sla-calculation.xlsx). This estimate is conservative and intended to expedite your exec review.

Proposed commercial remediation steps:
1) Apply the one-time credit (9%) to the November invoice.
2) Formalize a contract amendment to add a capacity buffer clause for mission-critical workloads (we propose a reserved-capacity addendum or guaranteed warm standby at 20% of committed throughput).
3) Add an operational runbook and a quarterly joint fire-drill cadence to reduce future reaction time.

We can put draft amendment language into DocuSign once Sigma confirms the preferred path (reserved capacity add-on vs. buffer pricing). For urgency, I'm happy to join an exec call Monday.

Jonas Weber
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference

Attachment: sla-calculation.xlsx
From: Sara Patel <sara.patel@sigmahealth.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Cc: SigmaHealth Legal <contracts@sigmahealth.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Nov 2027 16:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SLA credit estimate and proposed contract amendment language

Jonas / Ben —

Thank you for the quick response and the rollback. The 9% one-time credit and the reserved-capacity addendum approach sound reasonable to our execs. Two asks before we proceed:
1) Please send a formal one-page credit memo that our finance team can attach to the November invoice.
2) Draft DocuSign with the reserved-capacity addendum (we prefer the warm-standby model at 20% committed capacity; include lead time for activation and pricing).

We'll have our legal review the amendment; please copy contracts@sigmahealth.com on the DocuSign. Are you able to get the credit memo and the DocuSign draft to us by EOD tomorrow?

Regards,
Sara Patel
Head of Platform Operations, SigmaHealth

-----
SigmaHealth requested call: Monday 11/22 10:00 PT — accepted
